<div class="card-body">
'''Don't Underestimate Our Chances''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">我々にもチャンスはある</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使う。負けた側の戦闘ダメージを3倍にする。2：「敵を過大評価しすぎだ」の結果を3倍にする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-77o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">緊急配備。デス・スター接近中。15分後に、敵の射程圏内に達する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' There is still a chance.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. Just after the opponent initiates a battle, triple the loser's battle damage. Triple the result of 敵を過大評価しすぎだ.

'''Lore:''' Stand-by alert. Death Star approaching. Estimated time to firing range, fifteen minutes.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Option 2 names 敵を過大評価しすぎだ; the English names You Overestimate Their Chances.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
